mapper.insert: insert into wl_video_progress(user_id,course_id,video_id,progress_seconds,finished,last_play_time,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time,del_flag) values(#{userId},#{courseId},#{videoId},#{progressSeconds},#{finished},#{lastPlayTime},#{createBy},now(),'',now(),'0') on duplicate key update progress_seconds=values(progress_seconds),finished=values(finished),last_play_time=values(last_play_time),update_time=now()
mapper.select: select id,user_id,course_id,video_id,progress_seconds,finished,last_play_time from wl_video_progress where user_id=#{userId} and del_flag='0' order by last_play_time desc
